objections.text: Whether a fine-grained token returns the header github-authentication-token-expiration is not settled by GitHub's documentation (a 2021 changelog only); without it the weekly check says 'expiry unknown' and passes, so the announcement D-9 wants may never fire. The runbook must tell the author to note the expiry date at creation.
The documentation does not say whether a job naming an environment from a branch its rule excludes fails or is skipped; the design must not depend on which (plan refuses a ref other than main first).
